tech.title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
tech.desc: Amazon has its own cohort of foundation models, along with one of the most popular inference platforms on the internet. As long as they're under no legal obligation to open the doors to Muse, why would they?

tech.title: X will now tell users when governments have forced it to limit their posts
tech.desc: X is expanding its “Under the Hood” transparency tool to show when posts have been downranked or withheld in response to local laws and government demands, including which country made the request.

tech.title: Oura’s $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders
tech.desc: Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake in Oura for as much as $1.26 billion, according to Oura's latest IPO filing.

tech.title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
tech.desc: Tabby is designed to be a real-time bookkeeping interface, handling clients’ paperwork as it gives them up-to-the-minute data on their business’s profit and loss.
